{"type":"flowgraph","mermaid":"graph TD subgraph Container["Container: retold-stack"] Process1["Node process 1 (main): retold-remote
├─ HTTP server on :7777
├─ Orator-Conversion embedded
└─ Ultravisor Beacon client -> connects to :54321"] Process2["Node process 2 (child): ultravisor
├─ HTTP server on :54321
├─ Datastore at /data/ultravisor/datastore
└─ Staging at /data/ultravisor/staging"] Tools["Shell tools: ffmpeg, ffprobe, sharp (native), convert, 7z,
pdftk, pdftoppm, soffice, ebook-convert, audiowaveform, exiftool, dcraw"] Volumes["Volumes:
/media (ro, host media folder)
/cache (rw, named volume: retold-cache)
/data (rw, named volume: ultravisor-data)
/config (rw, named volume: retold-config)"] end RemoteUI["http://nas:7777/
(Retold Remote UI)"] UltravisorUI["http://nas:54321/
(Ultravisor UI)"] Process1 --> RemoteUI Process2 --> UltravisorUI ","style":"notebook"}
